cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I folded the ladder the way you did. First sausage for me, and I'll bring it over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine folds when I pull the pin. You've bent the brace on yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, a firmer fold. Help me straighten it and you can have it for two sausages.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll straighten it, but you'll have to hold it while I climb. It won't lock now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three sausages if I'm the lock as well. Bring one before you go up.
